text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To run faster and stronger than anyone in 
history at the historic Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), she prepared a secret strategy 
for this year's summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Namely, studying under Sakura Bakushin O! 
When it comes to speed, she's the one. And 
for that, starting at 4 AM... Wait, 4 in 
the morning?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No time to whine and complain, though! 
Together with her, Tosen Jordan began her 
full-throttle Bakushin sprint.
